summary: To store a vault password in a file, put it on a single line, restrict permissions, keep it out of source control, and pass it with --vault-password-file.
questions: How do I store a vault password in a file?
How do I run a playbook using a vault password file?
Should I commit my vault password file to git?

answer_card.title: Vault password files
answer_card.answer_md:
Put the password on a single line in a file, set restrictive permissions, and **don't commit it** to source control. Then:

```bash
ansible-playbook --extra-vars @secrets.enc --vault-password-file secrets.pass
```
